chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When Yusuf met his brother, he said to him: 'O my brother, how were you able to marry women after me?' He said: 'My father commanded me and said: If you are able to have offspring for yourself who fill the earth with the glorification (of God), then do so.'

key_terms.التَّسْبِيح: Glorification (tasbih) — the ritual utterance of 'Subhan Allah' (Glory be to God), here signifying constant devotional practice
key_terms.تُثْقِل الْأَرْض: Literally 'weigh down/fill the earth' — idiomatic for filling the earth completely, an abundance that permeates creation
key_terms.ذُرِّيَّة: Offspring, progeny — used here to denote descendants who carry on spiritual practice

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq narrate about Prophet Yusuf's reunion with his brother and the virtue of having children?
ai.summary: Imam Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates a conversation between Prophet Yusuf (Joseph, AS) and his brother Binyamin after their reunion. When Yusuf asks how his brother managed to marry after being separated, Binyamin explains their father Prophet Ya'qub (Jacob) had instructed him to marry and strive to have as many children as possible who would glorify God. This hadith is found in the chapter on the merits of having children, presenting marriage and offspring as an act of worship that amplifies divine glorification across the earth. The original audience — students of Imam al-Sadiq — would have understood this as both theological grounding and practical encouragement for family formation as a spiritual duty.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Yusuf<sup>as</sup> met his<sup>as</sup> brother, he asked him<sup>as</sup>, ‘How were you able to marry the women after me?’ He<sup>as</sup> said: ‘My<sup>as</sup> father<sup>as</sup> ordered me and said: ‘If you<sup>as</sup> have the ability to have as many offspring for yourself<sup>as</sup>, making the earth heavy by the Glorification (of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>), so do it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When Yusuf ‘Alayhi al-Salam, met his brother, he asked him, ‘How could you marry women after me?’ He replied, ‘My father commanded me and said, ‘If you like to have such a number of children who can make the earth heavy with Tasbih (Allah is free of all defects) you must do so.’”
